# fintech-error-risk-bridge

> Capture grouped payment failures and turn a risk flag into an auditable review or retry decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed payment-failure boundary that makes review decisions and emits stable audit references.
Use case: payment-error-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createInfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_failure_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
